items.title: Mike Wofford interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: But then shortly after that then I discovered Monk and Miles and the people

ctx.x: Well you can pretty much go out and make your own these days for not that much money too.

Yeah, exactly. A lot of people do. They buy their own stampers and literally you can produce CDs at home now, and buy the jewel boxes. So I don’t know. But then shortly after that then I discovered Monk and Miles and the people, the really historic people on the east coast who had changed the face of the music. And I had seen Duke live here when I was still a kid. His band came to town, and I remember seeing Jazz at the Phil, that came through. So you know I’d had some good roots in that area. And there was…
So from hearing these records and then deciding that this is something that I want to try to do, how did you teach yourself how to play jazz?
